_doc: The shape of substrate/pvp-yelps.json (gitignored: this machine's lines). tools/m59-pvp-yelp.mjs: a LOUD character in a PvP moment says one line as its health falls into each zone (thresholds, percent of max), corrupted to that zone's Zalgo level (tools/m59-zalgo.mjs). With probability mix_original the line is instead an untiered callout from pvp-callouts.json, corrupted the same way. {enemy} is the attacker, {me} the speaker; a line may be { "text", "voice" } as for callouts. Lines are written plain: the corruption is applied when said.
